steps.name: Epilogue ~ A Certain Gathering
steps.objective: Welcome the visitor who has come to see [Valdrick].

lines.text: (Several people approach Valdrick as he sits enjoying the cool breeze.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's been a while, everyone. Since you've all come this far, I suppose I wasn't mistaken. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ziskad, my boy. Good to see you!

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, Sir Valdrick. Let's save the sparring for another time.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, I'll think about it. And Shynic, little one. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It has. Is today going to be fun?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's fun for me. Not sure about you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ugh... Sounds like a bother.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: And old Atkina, thank you for last time.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Not at all. It was only possible because you were there.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: And...
It's been a while, old man. I thought arriving empty-handed would disappoint you, so I brought a gift. People need their meat, after all.
(A cold-looking girl in white gestures, and an enormous block of ice descends from the sky.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: How did you know I love meat? You brought so much!
Even Weiss would be baffled if someone said you didn't like meat.
"...I do not believe you would abstain from meat... Valdrick..." Like that.
(The girl in white lowers her voice to imitate Weiss.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha! You do a wonderful impression of Weiss, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I should. After what he put me through, I could hardly forget. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Stop calling me "Lady," old man. Use my name. It's been hundreds of years since you started being formal because you owed my father a debt.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Has it been that long? I was grateful for his kindness. All right, I'll just call you Io. And I suppose I should do the same for Medea...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew. That's better. Thank you, old man. And make sure you share that meat with the people who look after you! It's mountain goat raised in the pure air of the snowfields.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I even aged it in Deborah's ice, so it'll melt the moment it touches your tongue.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, that sounds delicious.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I sent some to Tartarus for you too, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really? Thank you!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And I'll ask Mir to send some to everyone else, so no one feels left out. I'm sorry about you, Atkina. You don't eat...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Don't worry about me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I sent some to Medea too, though I don't know if she'll accept it.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'll pass it along. She listens to me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. Anyway, it's good to see everyone. You haven't forgotten me, have you? See? As long as we don't die, we'll meet again someday.
(Io smiles brightly and shakes everyone's hand, then opens her arms to embrace Shynic.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You're so small, Shynic. Perfect for hugging.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's unfair. This happened just when I was about to have a growth spurt. Sigh. I can't even die and be reborn. Anyway, Valdrick, why do you use everyone else's name but call me "little one"?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Huh? What's wrong with that? A little one's a little one.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Why have I wasted hundreds of years telling you? You're still too stupid to understand.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't worry about it, Shynic. Everyone in the world knows he's an idiot.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha! If Io says so, I suppose it must be true. But where's Medea?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I believe she needs some time, Sir Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Did something happen to her?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Wait until Medea tells you herself, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm. All right.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then shall we talk?
(Valdrick raises a hand and points toward somewhere in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Weiss should be over there. I don't know what he's planning, but his power keeps growing.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I understand what you mean, but the time isn't right yet.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I know, old man. What I'm saying is...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's hard to explain in words. So when the time comes, let's all go beat him to a pulp!!
